thread:
elaine (Partnerships): KiteModels pinged. They want to distribute quantized forks in South Asia via AWS Marketplace APAC and through KoruTech's SI bundles. Key asks: geo-restrictions, reseller commission + tax withholding, and a soft-launch exclusivity for KoruTech in IND/Pak/Bangla for 45 days.
arjun (Partnerships APAC): KiteModels insists on a hard download-block for certain territories and IP-level watermarking on marketplace downloads. KoruTech wants exclusivity in IND only, not region-wide.
koru-rep (KoruTech): we'd like IND 45-day preferred window for joint PR and solution demos. Not asking to block other SIs long-term.
sanjay (Legal): red flags: watermarking requirements need clarity (what data, who signs), export control warranties required, and we must handle tax withholding for payouts to non-US providers. Also need to prevent unapproved sublicensing of artifacts.
maria (Finance): tax point: marketplaces often withhold VAT and local taxes. We need to know if KiteModels will accept net settlement or require gross payments and handle their own VAT invoicing. Also, reseller commission structure (KoruTech wants 15%) affects our cut.
kitemodels-legal: KiteModels prefers a 75/25 hosted rev-share, will pay KoruTech 12% integration fee. They want marketplaces to be able to resell downloadable artifacts but with a signed NSP (no-public-swap) clause.
ops-bot: automated check -> sandboxing: suggested: label SKUs as "apac_restricted" and set download_allowed=false for gated regions. No sanctions hits found for KiteModels entity.
elaine (Partnerships): Proposed commercial approach: Hosted (Redwood) = 75/25; Marketplace downloadable SKU = 82/18 to appease marketplace margins; KoruTech SI fee = 12% on top of provider's share. Tax handling: Redwood collects marketplace VAT and gross receipts, pays provider net after withholding as per contract.
sanjay (Legal): Agree in principle. Need explicit clauses: (1) IP watermark spec and audit rights, (2) tax withholding mechanics and gross/net representation, (3) non-sublicense and NSP, (4) geo-block manifest list. Also require provider indemnity for export issues.
arjun (Partnerships APAC): For exclusivity ask: accept IND 45-day marketing exclusivity only if KiteModels funds co-marketing and provides local case studies. No code or distribution exclusivity. KoruTech please confirm.
koru-rep (KoruTech): Confirmed, marketing-only exclusivity is acceptable. We'll need joint PR assets by T-14 and an embargo aligned with AWS listing.
elaine (Partnerships): Action items: (1) Sanjay draft an addendum covering watermarking, geo-block list, tax withholding flow, and NSP clause; (2) Maria to model settlement flows + withholding scenarios and share example payments; (3) Arjun to negotiate KoruTech exclusivity to marketing-only; (4) Ops to add apac_restricted flag and download_allowed=false for gated SKUs. Please update by EOD Tue.
maria (Finance): I'll run numbers for gross vs net settlement examples and include VAT treatment for India (GST) and Bangladesh. Expect spreadsheet by Monday.
sanjay (Legal): Drafting addendum and will request KiteModels to confirm watermark spec and provide entity tax forms. Sending initial draft by Tuesday.
elain (Partnerships): thanks all. tagging @arjun @sanjay @maria @koru-rep @kitemodels-legal. We'll reconvene after KiteModels returns signed addendum. :thumbsup:
